papers.title: Benchmark AUC Is Not Deployable Reliability: A Cross-Dataset Audit of Off-the-Shelf Features for Surveillance Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Mohammadreza Rashidi
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, AI and Media Analysis Lab, Berlin, Germany
papers.intro: 本文通过一个跨数据集审计实验证明：基于冻结预训练特征（CLIP、DINOv2、ResNet-50、EfficientNet-B0）+ 最近邻距离的无监督视频异常检测器，在单数据集（同场景）设置下平均AUC为0.704，但跨数据集（跨场景）平均AUC骤降至0.499（接近随机猜测），且最强骨干网络DI…

papers.title: Learning Where and When: Patch-Based Spatiotemporal Localization in Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Hamza Karim, Nghia Nguyen, Lokman Bekit, Yasin Yilmaz
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于补丁的弱监督时空异常检测框架，通过近邻感知的Top-k多示例学习策略，在无边界框监督的情况下同时学习异常发生的“时间”和“空间”位置，并发布了新标注数据集以促进该方向的研究。

papers.title: FDM-MFVT: Few-step Sampling Diffusion Model for Mask-Free Virtual Try-On
papers.authors: Jiaxin Liu, Xiaoye Liang, Lai Jiang, Mai Xu, Jun Liu
papers.affiliations: Beihang University (School of Electronic Information Engineering, State Key Laboratory of Virtual Reality Technology and Systems); Zhongguancun Academy
papers.intro: 本文提出FDM-MFVT，一个仅需6步采样、完全无掩码的扩散模型，通过Outfit-aware Noise Optimization (OANO) 模块优化噪声初始化，以及Instruction-driven Try-on (IDT) 模块实现文本与视觉引导的试穿，并构建了30,000对的MFVT数…

papers.title: MirrorPPR: Exemplar-Based Portrait Photo Retouching
papers.authors: Zhihong Liu, Zheng Li, Jiachun Jin, Siqi Kou, Yitao Jian, Fengpei Yu, Zhijie Deng
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Triverse AI
papers.intro: 本文提出MirrorPPR框架，通过修图操作提取器与扩散Transformer结合，并配套数据自增强范式和大规模数据集，首次实现了基于示例的精细结构肖像修图。

papers.title: Occlusion-Robust Multi-Object Decoupling for Physics-Based Interaction
papers.authors: Xin Dong, Wenfeng Deng, Yansong Tang
papers.affiliations: Xin Dong - Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University & Pengcheng Laboratory; Wenfeng Deng - Pengcheng Laboratory; Yansong Tang - Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University
papers.intro: 提出一种无需掩码的、基于联合2D-3D扩散先验和几何相似性正则化的多物体无损解耦方法，从稀疏遮挡视角重建完整物体，实现多物体物理交互仿真。

papers.title: Beyond Trajectory Matching: Reflow with Marginal Distribution Alignment
papers.authors: Chen Wang, Peiran Yun, Pan Xie, Ke Deng
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University (Chen Wang, Peiran Yun, Ke Deng); Bytedance Inc (Pan Xie)
papers.intro: 本文提出一种边际对齐正则化器，通过追踪学生ODE的log密度变化和冻结教师模型的分数估计，在不引入辅助网络或对抗训练的前提下，弥补再流蒸馏中轨迹匹配损失对分布欠定的缺陷，从而提升少步生成质量。

papers.title: ASTAD: Asymmetric Style Transfer for Synthetic-to-Real Adaptation in Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Dingyi Yao, Xinqi Zhang, Lihui Peng, Jianming Hu, Danya Yao, Yi Zhang
papers.affiliations: Department of Automation, Tsinghua University, Beijing 100084, China
papers.intro: 论文正式提出“自动驾驶不对称风格迁移”（ASTAD）任务，并设计了无需训练的两阶段框架ASTModel，通过原型引导的语义先验提取和动态语义精化机制，在无标注真实风格图条件下实现语义一致的风格迁移。

papers.title: ScaleErasure: Inference-Time Minimal Intervention for Precise Concept Erasure in Next-Scale Autoregressive Image Generation
papers.authors: Cong Wang, Haiyu Wu, Zhiwei Jiang, Zifeng Cheng, Fei Shen, Yafeng Yin, Qing Gu
papers.affiliations: State Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University; National University of Singapore
papers.intro: 本文提出ScaleErasure，一种针对next-scale AR图像生成范式的推理时概念擦除方法，通过在尺度、token和比特通道三个维度上精确选择并引导与不安全概念最相关的logits，以最小干预实现高效、精准的概念擦除。

papers.title: Enhancing Part-Level Point Grounding for Any Open-Source MLLMs
papers.authors: Jin-Cheng Jhang, Fu-En Wang, Xin Yang, Nan Qiao, Lu Xia, Min Sun, Cheng-Hao Kuo
papers.affiliations: National Tsing Hua University（Jin-Cheng Jhang, Min Sun）；Amazon（Fu-En Wang, Xin Yang, Nan Qiao, Lu Xia, Cheng-Hao Kuo）
papers.intro: 本文提出一种通用框架，通过查询合成（Q-Synth）模块和注意力到点（A2P）解码器，在不微调任何MLLM参数的情况下，增强任意开源MLLMs的部件级点定位能力。

papers.title: When Does Synthetic CT Transfer? A Label-Free Donor/Host Diagnostic for Medical Vision-Language Model Routing on Real Lung CT
papers.authors: Fakrul Islam Tushar
papers.tags: medical image, image classification, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Department of Radiology and Imaging Sciences, University of Arizona
papers.intro: 本文通过供体/宿主（donor/host）分解机制，在合成CT上无标签地预测VLM能力向真实CT的迁移性，并基于此构建一个无需训练、仅用合成数据校准的选/混合/延迟路由委员会TrialCouncil，在肺CT三项任务上验证了预测的正确性。

papers.title: Again-Pose: Anchor-Guided Adaptive Inter-Frame Motion Cues Propagating for High-quality Human Pose Reconstruction
papers.authors: Shuaikang Zhu, Yiding Sun, Yang Yang
papers.affiliations: Shuaikang Zhu - School of Electronic and Information Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University; School of Software Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University; Yiding Sun - School of Software Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University; Yang Yang - School of Electronic and Information Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University
papers.intro: 本文提出Again-Pose框架，通过显式锚框选择、双路径运动感知模块和差分加权融合，将极端运动场景下的姿态估计转化为运动引导的修复任务，显著提升鲁棒性和稳定性。

papers.title: Can OCR-VLMs Read Devanagari? A Stress-Test Benchmark and Post-Correction Study
papers.authors: Aditya Pratap Singh
papers.intro: 本文通过对10个OCR系统在天城文上的合成和真实扫描基准测试，发现合成文本掩盖真实性能、专用OCR-VLMs存在灾难性重复失败、英文性能不能预测印度文字性能，并提出错误分类和基于ByT5的分布匹配后纠正方法。

papers.title: Efficient Spatio-Temporal Grounding with Multimodal Large Models via Second-Level Tracking and RL Verification
papers.authors: Tianshu Zhang, Yan Wang, Ji Qi, Lijie Wen
papers.tags: visual grounding, tracking, multimodal learning, video search
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于秒级跟踪（second-level tracking）的MLLM时空定位管道，通过将处理单位从帧提升到秒、跨秒平滑、带地面真值坐标校正的CoT监督以及基于验证器的强化学习，在保持较高定位质量的同时显著降低长视频推理成本。

papers.title: RSICCLLM: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Remote Sensing Image Change Captioning
papers.authors: Yelin Wang, Zijia Song, Shuo Ye, Chuanguang Yang, Miaoyu Wang, Yong Xu, Zhulin An, Yongjun Xu, Zitong Yu
papers.tags: image captioning, multimodal learning, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China; Great Bay University, Dongguan, China; Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, China; Dongguan Key Laboratory for Intelligence and Information Technology, Dongguan, China
papers.intro: 本文提出RSICCLLM，首个用于遥感图像变化描述的大模型后训练框架，通过数据生成范式、差异感知监督微调和双负偏好优化，以7B参数超越更大规模模型。

papers.title: EchoSonar-R: A Multi-View Reasoning-Enabled Model for Disease Classification and Report Generation in Echocardiography
papers.authors: Darya Taratynova, Ahmed Aly, Numan Saeed, Mohammad Yaqub
papers.tags: medical image, image classification, object detection, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Division of Computing and Mathematical Sciences, Mohamed Bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI), Abu Dhabi, UAE
papers.intro: EchoSonar-R 是首个超声心动图多视图推理驱动视觉语言模型，通过融合时空视频编码与结构感知检测，经监督微调与组相对策略优化两阶段训练，联合实现多标签疾病分类和结构化报告生成。

papers.title: Monocular Avatar Reconstruction via Cascaded Diffusion Priors and UV-Space Differentiable Shading
papers.authors: Hong Li, Minqi Meng, Yanjun Liang, Chongjie Ye, Houyuan Chen, Weiqing Xiao, Xianda Guo, Guojun Lei, Xuhui Liu, Chaojie Yang, Yanlun Peng, Hao Zhao, Baochang Zhang
papers.affiliations: Beihang University, Great Wall Motors, CUHK-Shenzhen, HKUST, Nanjing University, Wuhan University, Zhejiang University, KAUST, AIR (Tsinghua University)
papers.intro: 提出一个数据高效的框架，利用统一预训练扩散模型通过级联LoRA适配器在UV空间中顺序完成纹理补全、光照均匀化和材质分解，并引入UV空间可微BRDF着色损失以保证物理合理性，用少于100个真实扫描就能生成4K分辨率完整PBR资产。

papers.title: Translation as a Bridging Action: Transferring Manipulation Skills from Humans to Robots
papers.authors: Sijin Chen, Kaixuan Jiang, Haixin Shi, Yanhui Wang, Weiheng Zhong, Haosheng Li, Bo Jiang, Yuxiao Liu, Xihui Liu
papers.intro: 本文提出将相对腕部平移（在初始头部相机帧内）作为人类与机器人共享的桥接动作表示，并设计交错动作令牌的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过跨本体动作的数据混合和训练策略，实现从人类到双臂机器人的操作技能迁移。

papers.title: PhysisForcing: Physics Reinforced World Simulator for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Peiwen Zhang, Yufan Deng, Shangkun Sun, Juncheng Ma, Duomin Wang, Jonas Du, Zilin Pan, Ye Huang, Hao Liang, Songyan Huang, Ruihua Zhang, Enze Xie, Ming-Yu Liu, Daquan Zhou
papers.intro: 提出PhysisForcing，一个在训练时通过像素级轨迹对齐和语义级关系对齐、聚焦物理信息区域的分层物理对齐训练框架，显著提升机器人操作视频生成的物理合理性，并改善下游世界模型规划与策略学习的成功率。

papers.title: OSOR: One-Step Diffusion Inpainting for Effect-Aware Object Removal
papers.authors: Qinming Zhou, Chenxi Sun, Deyang Kong, Junhao He, Xiangheng Tang, Peike Yu, Haotian Wu, Leilei Cao, Linfeng Zhang
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Tsinghua University, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Xidian University, Tongji University, Transsion
papers.intro: 提出了OSOR，一个单步扩散修复模型，通过占用引导的判别器、轻量级alpha头和语义锚定验证管道，实现了高效、效果感知和掩膜鲁棒的对象移除，在感知质量上超越多步扩散基线，同时推理速度快4-30倍。

papers.title: Diffusion Model Attribution via Spectral Coupling of Denoiser Responses
papers.authors: Pragati Shuddhodhan Meshram, Varun Chandrasekaran
papers.affiliations: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering)
papers.intro: 提出频谱去噪签名（Spectral Denoising Signatures, SDS），一种非侵入性模型归属方法，通过向去噪器输入频率受控的噪声并测量其跨频带能量耦合，提取模型内在的频谱几何签名，无需反转、优化或模型修改，在高相似模型中达到约99.9%的归属准确率。
